bio.text: Angela "Heli" Rodriguez Prilliman, of Fort Worth, is a Democratic candidate for Congress in Texas's 12th District in 2026, according to her campaign website.
The website says she was raised in Stephenville, graduated from Texas A&M University, and is an entrepreneur with more than a decade of experience in the startup world.

It says she founded the nail salon and education company Lacquerbar, was part of the founding team at the software company Fivestars, and is an entrepreneur-in-residence at the accelerator FourthWave.
